## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
All signals agree; the conformal set holds Invasive only [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Dominant |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, 90% level | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 100th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept-model link to invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Scarce gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low score is associated with invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical; associated with invasion · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 3, 5, 8) · context · 75% of nuclei neoplastic, 97th percentile [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test passes: removing top 3 regions lowers invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Deletion test not shown (CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0). Frequent mitotic figures is Unreliable (0/20) yet carries the second-largest weight here.

## Could be wrong if
- Cell counts come from regions 3, 5, 8 only.
- Calibration is checked on only 132 images; 100% may overstate certainty.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 7:** confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 11:** count mitoses yourself; concept failed its spot check.
3. **Border regions:** confirm suggested tumor at all four margins (simulated) [F11].
